NFC 3DLP: ITX PC-Gehäuse mit LP-GPU-Unterstützung

https://makerworld.com/de/models/2604148-nfc-3dlp-itx-pc-case-with-lp-gpu-support?from=search#profileId-2873660

🧃 A Fully 3D Printed ITX Case That Actually Works

 

Not just a concept—this is a practical, daily-usable mini-ITX case designed to be easy to print and genuinely enjoyable to build.

* Low-profile GPU ready (A2000, A4000 ada SFF, Arc B50)
* FLEX ATX PSU + ~70mm cooler support
* Strong airflow with clean cable management
 

🎥 See the full build:

https://youtu.be/AQvHvRZw62k

 

💛STEP Files available for Patreon supporters

 

🧠 Design Philosophy

 

The goal of the 3DLP is simple: make a fully 3D printed case that is actually good.

 

Instead of chasing extreme compactness, this design prioritizes:

* Easy printing (no supports!)
* Straightforward assembly (snap guides + glue)
* Strong airflow and cooling (with correct hardware)
* STRONG and a beautiful design
 

The outer shell acts as an exoskeleton, allowing parts to slide in and lock into place cleanly and allows for durable portability.

 

This is a case designed for 3D printing from the ground up.

 

 

🧱 Key Features

* Support-less design (for most materials)
* Simple assembly with minimal hardware
* Superglue-friendly bonding (recommended for the tray, but not strictly necessary)
* NFC Sconeslot ventilation for airflow and aesthetics
* Build plate textures used for improved surface finish
* Geometry optimized for strength and reduced warping
* Optional multi-color logo insert support
 

📦 Files Included

* STL and 3MF files for all printed parts
* Optimized orientations
* Modular design for customization
 

🧩 Recommended Materials

* PETG for the TRAY and REAR
* PLA can be used for everything else*
* *If you put a transverse fin GPU in, then switch the shell to PETG.
* Glass Fiber or Carbon Fiber filaments will make the shell super premium looking!
Designed to print well even in PLA thanks to airflow and structure.

 

 

🔧 Build Notes

 

* Use light bed adhesive for reliable first layers
* Keep enclosure open for PLA printing
* Use minimal superglue and clamp where possible
* Test-fit parts before final assembly

Druckeinstellungen:
- Druckprofil: PETG + PLA Recommend Profile
- Schichthöhe: 0.2 mm
- Wandlinien: 2
- Infill: 15%
- Filament: PLA (#0069B1), PETG (#9E007E)
